text:
maria.g: deploy-bot alerted a values drift in eu-west-staging for payments-service. saw it around the 11:30 canary. can someone confirm if this is the overlay toggle change?

deploy-bot: [AUTOMATED] Canary check failed for payments-service chart v2.3.4 in eu-west-staging.
  - failed check: values checksum mismatch (expected 6a1f3d, got 9b2e4c)
  - affected: configmap payment-feature-toggle, ingress annotations
  - action: canary paused, releasehold applied

kevin: I flipped that toggle earlier for a quick smoke (to test payflow flags). my bad, forgot to promote the overlay to staging.

jen: thanks — do we prefer to pin the chart to v2.3.3 and hotpatch or promote the overlay and resume canary?

alexa: if we promote the overlay we should run a short smoke next 5m. pinning will be faster but means another release bump later.

maria.g: @kevin can you push the overlay to staging now? if not, we'll pin and roll forward with a post-deploy hotfix.

kevin: pushing now. helm diff shows only the toggle key.

kevin: ran `helm upgrade --install payments-service ./charts/payments -f overlays/eu-west/staging.yaml --set config.featureToggle.payments=true --dry-run`

jenn: deploy-bot — re-run canary when overlay promoted?

deploy-bot: [AUTOMATED] Re-enqueue: canary for payments-service v2.3.4 scheduled. preflight checks queued.

alexa: if the dry-run looks clean, let's let canary finish. release notes should mention the toggle re-enable and include the checksum.

maria.g: agree. release notes snippet for QA: "Re-enabled legacy payments toggle in eu-west staging; no code changes. Canary paused automatically on checksum mismatch."

release-bot: Release notes draft saved to https://internal.redwood/release-notes/payments/2.3.4 - assigned to @jen for final blurb.

jen: ack. I'll add the rollback rationale and tag the post-deploy hotfix if canary fails.

kevin: canary passed in eu-west after overlay promotion. deploy-bot cleared the hold. :tada:

deploy-bot: [AUTOMATED] Canary success. releasehold removed. Finalizing promote -> production window at 18:00 UTC if no regressions.

maria.g: copying decision here — no pin, overlay promoted, canary validated. monitor logs for 30m after promote. if any spike, we'll manual rollback to v2.3.3 and cut hotfix branch.

alexa: will watch. tagging ops on-call. :eyes:
